contexts.text: Cottages built of rushes and reeds plastered with lime.
They differ as... lime and silver.
The walls of (Melancthon's) chamber appeared plastered with lime. TCR 797:end.

The destruction of the Church as to the truths of worship is described by to place the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are scattered () ... As chalk stones that are scattered = as falsities which do not cohere.
